questions.q: Who is the main protagonist of the story 'January Night'?
questions.explanation: मुंशी प्रेमचंद की कहानी 'January Night' (पूस की रात) का मुख्य पात्र हल्कू (Halku) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the name of Halku's dog in 'January Night'?
questions.explanation: हल्कू के वफादार कुत्ते का नाम जबरा (Jabra) था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How much money had Halku saved to buy a blanket?
questions.explanation: हल्कू ने कंबल खरीदने के लिए बड़ी मेहनत से तीन रुपये (Three rupees) बचाए थे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who was the landlord (sahna) demanding money from Halku?
questions.explanation: सहना (Sahna/Landlord) हल्कू से लगान के पैसे मांगने आया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who advised Halku to give up tenant farming and work as a hired laborer?
questions.explanation: हल्कू की पत्नी मुन्नी (Munni) ने उसे मजूरी (hired labor) करने की सलाह दी थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What destroyed Halku's crop while he was sleeping near the fire?
questions.explanation: नीलगायों के झुंड (A herd of nilgais) ने हल्कू की पूरी फसल बर्बाद कर दी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How did Halku warm himself in the freezing January night?
questions.explanation: हल्कू ने बगीचे से सूखी पत्तियां इकट्ठा कर उन्हें जलाकर अपनी ठंड दूर की।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did Halku feel relieved at the end of the story despite losing his crop?
options: He wouldn't have to sleep in the cold field anymore
questions.explanation: फसल नष्ट होने के बाद हल्कू खुश था क्योंकि अब उसे कड़ाके की ठंड में खेत पर नहीं सोना पड़ेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did Munni say when she saw the ruined field in the morning?
options: 'Now you will have to pay the taxes by earning as a laborer.'
questions.explanation: मुन्नी ने दुखी होकर कहा कि अब मजूरी करके मालगुजारी भरनी पड़ेगी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does 'January Night' depict about the life of Indian farmers?
options: The tragic plight and exploitation of poor tenant farmers
questions.explanation: यह कहानी गरीब किसानों की दयनीय स्थिति और शोषण (tragic plight) को दर्शाती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is 'Allergy' according to Dr. Rana S.P. Singh?
options: A malfunction of the human immune system
questions.explanation: डॉ. राणा एस.पी. सिंह के अनुसार एलर्जी मानव प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली (immune system) की एक असामान्य प्रतिक्रिया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Substances that cause allergic reactions are called ________.
questions.explanation: एलर्जी पैदा करने वाले पदार्थों को एलर्जेंस (Allergens) कहा जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which of the following is a common indoor allergen mentioned in the chapter?
questions.explanation: धूल के कण (Dust mites) और पंख घर के भीतर पाए जाने वाले प्रमुख एलर्जेन हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What antibody is produced by the immune system during an allergic reaction?
questions.explanation: एलर्जी के दौरान शरीर में IgE (इम्यूनोग्लोबुलिन ई) नामक एंटीबॉडी बनती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which condition is a severe respiratory symptom of allergy?
questions.explanation: दमा (Asthma) एलर्जी का एक गंभीर श्वसन संबंधी लक्षण है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is 'Eczema' mentioned in the chapter 'Allergy'?
options: An allergic skin disease causing itching
questions.explanation: एक्जिमा (Eczema) त्वचा की एक एलर्जी है जिसमें तेज खुजली और चकत्ते होते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: According to the chapter, allergies can be ________ in nature.
questions.explanation: लेखक बताते हैं कि एलर्जी अक्सर आनुवंशिक (Genetic/Hereditary) हो सकती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the best way to prevent allergic reactions?
questions.explanation: एलर्जी से बचने का सबसे अच्छा उपाय एलर्जेंस के संपर्क से दूर रहना (Avoiding contact) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Pollen grains from trees and grasses are examples of ________ allergens.
questions.explanation: पेड़-पौधों के परागकण (Pollen grains) बाहरी (Outdoor) एलर्जेन के उदाहरण हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What role do antihistamines play in treating allergies?
questions.explanation: एंटीहिस्टामाइन दवाएं एलर्जी के लक्षणों से राहत (relieve symptoms) प्रदान करती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of the story 'The Bet'?
questions.explanation: 'The Bet' (शर्त) के प्रसिद्ध लेखक रूसी साहित्यकार एंटोन चेखव (Anton Chekhov) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Between whom was the bet made in the story?
options: A banker and a young lawyer
questions.explanation: यह शर्त एक अमीर बैंकर और एक युवा वकील (banker and lawyer) के बीच लगी थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the main topic of discussion at the banker's party?
questions.explanation: पार्टी में मृत्युदंड और आजीवन कारावास (Capital punishment vs life imprisonment) पर बहस हो रही थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the stake money for the bet?
questions.explanation: शर्त की राशि दो मिलियन रूबल (Two million rubles) तय की गई थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: For how many years did the young lawyer agree to stay in solitary confinement?
questions.explanation: युवा वकील पंद्रह वर्ष (Fifteen years) तक एकांत कारावास में रहने के लिए तैयार हो गया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did the lawyer spend his time doing during his solitary confinement?
options: Reading books, studying languages, and playing music
questions.explanation: बंदी जीवन के दौरान वकील ने ढेरों पुस्तकें पढ़ीं, भाषाएं सीखीं और संगीत सुना।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What happened to the banker's financial condition over the 15 years?
options: He lost his fortune on the stock exchange
questions.explanation: 15 वर्षों में बैंकर को शेयर बाजार में भारी घाटा हुआ और वह लगभग कंगाल हो गया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did the banker plan to do on the last night before the bet expired?
options: To run away from the country
To kill the lawyer to avoid paying the two millions
questions.explanation: पैसे देने से बचने के लिए बैंकर ने वकील की हत्या करने (To kill the lawyer) की योजना बनाई।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did the banker find on the lawyer's table when he entered the lodge?
options: A letter renouncing the two millions and despising worldly wisdom
questions.explanation: मेज पर एक पत्र मिला जिसमें वकील ने 2 मिलियन की राशि को ठुकरा दिया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did the lawyer leave his lodge five minutes before the agreed time?
options: To intentionally lose the bet and prove his disdain for money
questions.explanation: वकील ने जानबूझकर समय से 5 मिनट पहले कमरा छोड़ दिया ताकि वह शर्त हार जाए और पैसे न लेने पड़ें।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of the story 'Quality'?
questions.explanation: 'Quality' (गुणवत्ता) के लेखक प्रसिद्ध अंग्रेजी साहित्यकार जॉन गाल्सवर्दी (John Galsworthy) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the name of the shoemaker in the story 'Quality'?
questions.explanation: कहानी में जर्मन जूता-निर्माता का नाम मिस्टर गेसलर (Mr. Gessler) था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Where was Mr. Gessler's boot shop located?
options: In a small by-street in London
questions.explanation: मिस्टर गेसलर की दुकान लंदन की एक छोटी सी गली (by-street in London) में थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What sign did Mr. Gessler's shop have outside?
questions.explanation: दुकान के बाहर केवल 'गेसलर ब्रदर्स' (Gessler Brothers) का बोर्ड लगा हुआ था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How did Mr. Gessler view his craft of bootmaking?
options: As an art ('Id is an Ardt!')
As a quick way to get rich
questions.explanation: मिस्टर गेसलर जूता बनाने के काम को एक पवित्र कला (Art) मानते थे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did Mr. Gessler dislike big modern firms?
options: Because they got business through advertisement, not quality
questions.explanation: गेसलर का मानना था कि बड़ी कंपनियां गुणवत्ता के बल पर नहीं, बल्कि विज्ञापनों के बल पर ग्राहक जुटाती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What materials did Mr. Gessler use to make his boots?
questions.explanation: वह जूते बनाने के लिए सर्वोत्तम गुणवत्ता वाले चमड़े (best leather) का उपयोग करते थे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What happened to Mr. Gessler's elder brother?
options: He died of grief and losing business
questions.explanation: व्यापार छिन जाने और सदमे के कारण गेसलर के बड़े भाई की मृत्यु हो गई थी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the cause of Mr. Gessler's death at the end of the story?
options: Slow starvation due to working tirelessly without eating
questions.explanation: गेसलर ने बिना खाए-पिए दिन-रात जूते बनाए, जिसके कारण भुखमरी (starvation) से उनकी मौत हो गई।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the central theme of 'Quality'?
options: The tragic decline of dedicated craftsmanship in the modern commercial world
questions.explanation: यह कहानी आधुनिक व्यावसायिक दुनिया में सच्चे और समर्पित हस्तशिल्प के पतन को दर्शाती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
options: He says that he was reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.
He said that I was reading a book.
He said that he is reading a book.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb Past में होने पर Present Continuous बदलकर Past Continuous (was reading) हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said to me, 'You are my best friend.'
options: She told me that I was her best friend.
She told me that you are my best friend.
She asked me that I was her best friend.
She said to me that I am her best friend.
questions.explanation: 'said to' को 'told' में बदलते हैं; 'You' me के अनुसार 'I' और 'my' she के अनुसार 'her' हो जाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Ram said, 'I have completed the work.'
options: Ram said that he has completed the work.
Ram said that he had completed the work.
Ram says that he had completed the work.
Ram said that I had completed the work.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect (have completed) बदलकर Past Perfect (had completed) हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He says, 'I work hard.'
options: He says that he worked hard.
He said that he worked hard.
He says that he works hard.
He says that I work hard.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb Present (says) में होने पर Reported speech का Tense नहीं बदलता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: They said, 'We went to Patna yesterday.'
options: They said that they had gone to Patna the previous day.
They told that they had gone to Patna yesterday.
They said that they went to Patna yesterday.
They said that we had gone to Patna the previous day.
questions.explanation: Past Simple (went) बदलकर Past Perfect (had gone) और 'yesterday' 'the previous day' हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said, 'I will buy a pen tomorrow.'
options: She told that she will buy a pen the next day.
She said that she will buy a pen tomorrow.
She said that she would buy a pen tomorrow.
She said that she would buy a pen the next day.
questions.explanation: 'will' का 'would' और 'tomorrow' का 'the next day' हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said, 'The earth revolves around the sun.'
options: The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher told that the earth revolved around the sun.
The teacher says that the earth revolves around the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
questions.explanation: Universal Truth (सार्वभौमिक सत्य) का Tense Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to her, 'I cannot help you.'
options: He told her that I could not help her.
He said to her that he could not help you.
He told her that he cannot help her.
He told her that he could not help her.
questions.explanation: 'cannot' बदलकर 'could not' हो जाएगा और Pronouns नियमानुसार बदलेंगे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Sita said, 'I wrote a letter.'
options: Sita said that she wrote a letter.
Sita says that she had written a letter.
Sita said that she had written a letter.
Sita said that I had written a letter.
questions.explanation: Past Simple (wrote) बदलकर Past Perfect (had written) हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am glad to be here this evening.'
options: He said that he is glad to be here this evening.
He said that he was glad to be here that evening.
He told that he was glad to be there this evening.
He said that he was glad to be there that evening.
questions.explanation: 'here' का 'there' और 'this' का 'that' हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, 'Are you going home?'
options: He told me if I was going home.
He asked me if I was going home.
He asked me if was I going home.
He asked me that if I was going home.
questions.explanation: Interrogative में 'said to' को 'asked' में और योजक के रूप में 'if/whether' लगाते हैं; वाक्य साधारण बन जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said to him, 'What is your name?'
options: She asked him what was his name.
She told him what his name was.
She asked him what his name was.
She asked him that what his name was.
questions.explanation: Wh-word वाले प्रश्नों में वही Wh-word योजक बनता है और उसके बाद Subject + Verb आता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Ram said to Sita, 'Where do you live?'
options: Ram asked Sita where she lived.
Ram asked Sita where did she live.
Ram told Sita where she lived.
Ram asked Sita where do you live.
questions.explanation: Present Simple Interrogative (Where do you live) बदलकर Past Simple Assertive (where she lived) हो जाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, 'Did you see the match?'
options: He told me if I had seen the match.
He asked me if I had seen the match.
He asked me if did I see the match.
He asked me if I saw the match.
questions.explanation: Past Simple (Did you see) बदलकर Past Perfect (had seen) हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said to Mohan, 'Why are you late?'
options: The teacher asked Mohan why was he late.
The teacher told Mohan why he was late.
The teacher asked Mohan that why he was late.
The teacher asked Mohan why he was late.
questions.explanation: 'Why' योजक बनेगा और 'are you late' बदलकर 'he was late' हो जाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: My friend said to me, 'Can you help me?'
options: My friend asked me that if I could help him.
My friend asked me if I could help him.
My friend told me if I could help him.
My friend asked me if can I help him.
questions.explanation: 'Can' बदलकर 'could' होगा और योजक 'if' लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said to me, 'Have you finished your lunch?'
options: She asked me if I had finished my lunch.
She asked me if had I finished my lunch.
She told me if I had finished my lunch.
She asked me if I have finished my lunch.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Interrogative बदलकर Past Perfect Assertive (if I had finished) हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to her, 'Will you come with me?'
options: He told her if she would come with him.
He asked her if she will come with him.
He asked her if would she go with him.
He asked her if she would go with him.
questions.explanation: 'Will' का 'would' और 'come' का 'go' (अर्थ के अनुसार) हो जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The police said to the man, 'Where are you going?'
options: The police asked the man where he was going.
The police told the man where he was going.
The police asked the man where was he going.
The police asked the man that where he was going.
questions.explanation: सही संरचना 'where he was going' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, 'Do you know English?'
options: He asked me if I know English.
He asked me if did I know English.
He told me if I knew English.
He asked me if I knew English.
questions.explanation: Present Simple (Do you know) बदलकर Past Simple (I knew) हो जाएगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the meaning of the idiom 'A bed of roses'?
questions.explanation: 'A bed of roses' का अर्थ है अत्यंत सुखद और आरामदायक स्थिति।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the meaning of the idiom 'Apple of one's eye'?
questions.explanation: 'Apple of one's eye' (आँख का तारा) का अर्थ है बहुत प्यारा होना।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the meaning of the idiom 'Once in a blue moon'?
questions.explanation: 'Once in a blue moon' (ईद का चाँद होना) का अर्थ है बहुत दुर्लभ या कभी-कभार होना।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: ईमानदारी सबसे अच्छी नीति है।
options: The honesty is the best policy.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है: 'Honesty is the best policy.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: दो और दो चार होते हैं।
questions.explanation: सही और मानक अंग्रेजी संरचना 'Two and two make four' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: वह पिछले सोमवार से बीमार है।
options: He has been ill since last Monday.
He is ill since last Monday.
He was ill since last Monday.
He has been ill from last Monday.
questions.explanation: निश्चित समय के साथ Present Perfect में 'has been ill since' लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: क्या आप मुझे अपनी पुस्तक दे सकते हैं?
options: Do you give me your book?
Are you give me your book?
Can you give me your book?
Will you giving me your book?
questions.explanation: क्षमता या निवेदन के लिए 'Can you give me...' सही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Diligent'?
questions.explanation: 'Diligent' (मेहनती/परिश्रमी) का पर्यायवाची 'Hardworking' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Optimist'?
questions.explanation: 'Optimist' (आशावादी) का विलोम 'Pessimist' (निराशावादी) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: 'Committee' (समिति) की सही स्पेलिंग 'Committee' है (डबल m, डबल t, डबल e)।
questions.subject: English
